source_authority: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare — Lok Sabha written reply, 22 Jul 2022 (PIB)
summary: Setting up of 22 new AIIMS approved under PMSSY; 6 fully functional (Bhopal, Bhubaneswar, Jodhpur, Patna, Raipur, Rishikesh); annexure gives status of the other 16.
plus: AIIMS New Delhi (All India Institute of Medical Sciences Act, 1956) — 23 AIIMS in all.
